about_the_game:
"Soul Gather is a spine-chilling indie horror experience that will test your nerves and reflexes. Set in a series of eerie, atmospheric levels, your goal is simple yet perilous: collect 10 elusive souls scattered across each map. But beware—you're not alone.

  • Challenging enemies that come out of nowhere

  • The game features Automatic Wall Climbing with 3D platforming mechanics not key bound

  • "Terrifying entities stalk your every move. From bloodthirsty demons and vengeful ghosts to grotesque clowns, deadly spiders, savage minotaur, and other nightmarish creatures, each level introduces new horrors that heighten the tension. With every soul you gather, the danger intensifies, forcing you to outwit and outrun your relentless pursuers."

    Game Highlights

    • Terrifying Entities:

      • Ghost girl  (powers Flight Teleportation, stalking partial wall phasing during teleport, )

      • Shadow shifter ( Powers Hide in the shadows, Wall phase flight Audio mimic sounds

      • Alien ghosts ( Powers Flight, Teleportation, ) Queen aliens to be added later

      • Demon nun the nuns shadow level ( Powers teleportation via player Distance)

      • Demon clown ( powers ( flight, wall phase, speed boost,)

      • Frost fang monster (snow map) ( powers Non patrols variable speeds low vision )

      • Spiders ( Power's non strength numbers shock and surprise ) 

      • Wraiths (The Wraith kings) (Powers Fade can fade in and out of reality fast movement speed weakness holy cross slows them down)

      • Giant skeleton Monster boss battle with Multiple AI ( weakness non) Run for your dam life ! 

      • Rouge souls ( red Spheres that help guide the player with audio and light indication) Aid on misty maps

      • Evil Wizard Powers Super teleportation ability's due to his vast magical power Flight intrusive hard to evade) 

    • Companionship: A pet dog Called GOOD BOY to assist in the cold or comfort players during one of the levels—a nice balance to the eerie atmosphere.

content_descriptors.notes: The game features spiders so anyone with Arachnophobia please be warned

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 - 4GB or Radeon RX 470 - 4GB
  • Storage: 320 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Godot 4.3 engine
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-11700k or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 - 8GB or AMD Radeon 6700 XT - 12GB
  • Storage: 320 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Godot 4.3 engine

short_description: "Soul Gather is an intense Challenging indie horror game where survival is key. collect 10 souls in each chilling level while evading relentless pursuers, including demons, ghosts, vampires, clowns, spiders, minotaur's, and more. Can you escape their grasp and gather all 10 of the Souls Per level ?
